spacing_review.note: Accepted. Read against the two joined pieces: the left piece ends with است: and the right piece begins with پنجاه; the colon after است closes the lead-in and the list begins with پنجاه, so without the space two words would run together. Checked by code point: the inserted character is U+0020 at index 188 of 411; a character that is not a space stands on each side of it; the field has no doubled space; and the mapped pieces of the two sources lie directly before and after it, so the space is the only character added. The row has no Arabic field, so only this one space is in question.
